cases.name: source-republication
cases.description: A Kustomization republishes the chart source during changed-only rendering.

cases.name: kustomization-rename
cases.description: An unchanged Kustomization still orders after the old declaration.

cases.name: helmrelease-rename
cases.description: A nested Kustomization supplies the namespace of a HelmRelease that orders after a release from another producer.

cases.description: An unchanged Kustomize replacement sets the HelmRelease dependency.

cases.description: An unchanged Kustomize component sets the HelmRelease dependency.

cases.name: helmrelease-rename-suspended
cases.description: The target of an unchanged suspended HelmRelease changes names.

cases.name: transitive-failure
cases.description: Two PVC declarations depend on an intermediate Kustomization that cannot proceed.

cases.description: The unchanged nested reader uses prefix.

cases.description: The unchanged nested reader uses prefix-configured.

cases.description: The unchanged nested reader uses patch.

cases.description: The unchanged nested reader uses patch-configured.

cases.description: An unchanged local patch adds the nested reader ordering dependency.

cases.name: helmrelease-rename-patch-dependency-strategic
cases.description: A strategic merge deletes one ordering edge while the other reader still requires the removed target.

cases.description: The first patch adds the label that the second patch selects.

cases.name: helmrelease-rename-patch-target
cases.description: A changed patch renames the target without editing its declaration file.

cases.name: helmrelease-rename-patch-target-and-producer
cases.description: The target patch and its producer change names while the dependent stays unchanged.

cases.name: helmrelease-rename-flux-patch
cases.description: An unchanged Flux Kustomization supplies its dependency patch through spec.patches.

cases.name: kustomization-rename-patch-reader
cases.description: An unchanged patch supplies a Kustomization ordering dependency.

cases.name: helmrelease-rename-patched-configmap
cases.description: A patched ConfigMap-only producer does not supply a HelmRelease reader.

cases.name: helmrelease-required-base-failure
cases.description: A changed-only build reports a required base producer failure and retains head output.

cases.name: helmrelease-rename-substitute-inline
cases.description: An inline value renames the target of an unchanged dependency patch.

cases.name: helmrelease-rename-substitute-replacement
cases.description: Flux string replacement renames an unchanged dependency target.

cases.name: helmrelease-rename-substitute-from
cases.description: Only a referenced ConfigMap changes the target of an unchanged dependency patch.

cases.description: Add a Flux name prefix to the dependency target.

cases.name: ordering-name-suffix
cases.description: Add a Flux name suffix to the dependency target.

cases.name: ordering-target-namespace
cases.description: Move the dependency target to a different namespace.

cases.name: ordering-flux-patch
cases.description: Rename the dependency target through a Flux patch.

cases.name: ordering-nested-component
cases.description: Rename the dependency target through a nested Kustomize component.

cases.name: ordering-replacement
cases.description: Replace the dependency target name with the Namespace name.

cases.name: ordering-relative-component
cases.description: Rename the dependency target inside a sibling component.

cases.name: ordering-relative-unrelated
cases.description: Change the reader outside the relative component and producer package.

cases.name: ordering-parent-path
cases.description: Move the producer package through an interior parent segment.

cases.description: Change the reader outside the package reached through an interior parent segment.
